source: test fixture — issue #339 review round 4: one combination prescription, two chip SUBJECTS, one of which the prescription's display names
description: drug-reference-combination-order-self-named.json with a THIRD drug that also rules on rifapentine, so ONE response raises two rule chips about the SAME co-medication from two different subjects. The order's own combination code J04AC51 is not in the dataset, so DrugSafetyValidator.orderPartners falls to soleSubstanceOf, resolves the covered J04AB05 to Rifapentine and OrderPartner.nameByOrder renames that partner after the ORDER. The display names Isoniazid, so a refusal keyed on the CHIP'S subject refuses the isoniazid chip and admits the carbamazepine one — one prescription, two names, which is the defect issue #339 exists to remove. The refusal is keyed on the RESPONSE's subjects instead, so both chips answer alike.

interactions.note: Rifapentine induces CYP3A4 and lowers isoniazid exposure.
Rifapentine induces CYP3A4 and lowers carbamazepine exposure.
